gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-biryani: Neuropolitical looks pulled apart letter by letter, each glowing neon-tube shape drawn as a single line. Biryani brings a large, clear eye to every e and no stroke contrast so its small counters stay unclogged.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-comme: Neuropolitical turns every word into spaced-out neon tubing, with rounds and stems matching in heft. But it earns its keep big and short, and Comme handles the rest with smooth curves that never clog.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-cossette-te: Cossette Texte has a wide-eyed e, n arches as sturdy as the stems beside them, and a prominent x-height. Then Neuropolitical glows overhead in spaced-out neon-tube letters, giving the text below a bright, steady opening.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-gafata: Neuropolitical pulls its letters apart, each one a glowing neon tube. The standout quality is that gentle monotone line meeting Gafata, a sans with short stalks above its band of letters and wide-eyed e shapes.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-georama: Georama has a c opened wide like a bracelet pulled apart, and its capitals barely rise above the lowercase. Yet Neuropolitical holds its crossbars as fat as the stems, so the glowing heading feels solid.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-golos-text: Neuropolitical glows like neon tubing, its letters pulled apart one by one. What holds them together is line: Golos Text, a sans-serif with a single stroke width and a widely parted s, echoes that neon line.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hedvig-lett: Neuropolitical draws every letter with a ruler-drawn, constant-width line, like glowing neon tubing pulled apart. Hedvig Letters Sans then adds a clear gap where the c ends, with small letters nearly matching the capitals in height.
